description: This source file defines the SaliencyPruner class, which inherits from BaseStructuredSparsifier and implements a saliency-based pruning method for neural network weights. It calculates saliency using the L1 norm of weight rows, and updates the pruning mask to remove the least salient rows based on a target sparsity level.

classes.name: SaliencyPruner
classes.description: A class for pruning neural network weight tensors based on the saliency metric (L1 norm of each row), targeting structured sparsity.

methods.name: update_mask(self, module, tensor_name, **kwargs)
methods.description: Calculates the saliency of each row in the weight tensor and updates the mask to prune a portion of the least salient rows based on the specified sparsity level.
